key_information_units.information: FY 2025 delivered strong financial performance with revenue increasing 33.9% to EUR 1.837 billion, EBITDA rising 60% to EUR 232.6 million, though net profit decreased to EUR 71.9 million due to one-off consolidation effects from Tallink Grupp.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table showing revenue, EBITDA, and net profit for 12 months 2025 vs 2024; accompanying note explains net profit decrease attributable to one-off effects from Tallink Grupp consolidation in 2024.

key_information_units.information: Q4 2025 revenue was EUR 417.4 million and EBITDA EUR 42.6 million, with net profit turning positive at EUR 14.1 million compared to a loss of EUR 11.9 million in Q4 2024.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures of Q4 2025 table (Q4 2025 vs Q4 2024 columns for revenue, EBITDA, and net profit); Events in Q4 2025 section lists factors impacting Q4 financial results.

key_information_units.information: Maritime transport segment saw passenger volumes fall 0.9% annually but Q4 EBITDA improved to EUR 27.6 million; Tallink sold the cargo vessel Sailor and extended the Silja Europa charter until January 2027.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report section on Maritime Transport (passenger and cargo unit volumes); Events in Q4 2025 section details Q4 maritime results and specific events (vessel sale, charter extension).

key_information_units.information: Energy segment increased sales volumes by 7% to 4.8 TWh in Q4 despite lower regional consumption; Elenger secured a multi-year LNG supply agreement for 12 cargoes and expanded battery storage capacity in Latvia while planning further developments in Estonia.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 section details Elenger sales volume increase, LNG agreement, and battery storage commissions/construction; Management Report describes regional consumption decline and seasonality.

key_information_units.information: Real estate segment advanced major infrastructure projects including Rail Baltica mainline construction (EUR 67.2 million contract ongoing until March 2028) and a 40,000 m² Depo commercial space development in Lasnamäe scheduled for completion in fall 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Real Estate Developments section in Events in Q4 2025 details Rail Baltica contract and Depo project timeline; Real estate portfolio overview table confirms project status.

key_information_units.information: Strategic expansion into agriculture accelerated with November 2025 acquisition of 100% stake in OÜ Oisu Biogaas, complementing existing biomethane production operations under OÜ Infortar Agro.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 section states 'In November, Infortar announced the acquisition of a 100% stake in OÜ Oisu Biogaas.'; Supporting Sectors section describes agriculture consolidation under OÜ Infortar Agro.

key_information_units.information: Liquidity strengthened with cash rising to EUR 219.8 million and net debt/EBITDA improving to 3.6x from 4.0x, driven by debt repayments and stable operating cash flows.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures table shows cash at end of period (219,771 thousand EUR vs 167,579 thousand EUR) and net debt/EBITDA ratios; Cash Flow Statement highlights operating cash flow generation and debt repayment activities.

key_information_units.information: Post-reporting events include extension of EUR 27 million loans maturing in 2026 to 2031 and Elenger Grupp's February 2026 acquisition of subsidiary SIA Mood Deco.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 14 (Events after the Reporting Date) details loan extension and Elenger acquisition announced on February 2, 2026.
